text: Across the four m2-fixed N=64 seeds on data_seed 0 (20-23), trained force R2 spans only 0.763-0.789, but force control R2 spans 0.542-0.63, which is wider than any within-run control_spread (0.015-0.032). Is the run-seed-dependent control the main source of variance in m2-fixed force margins? Would a control pool shared across seeds cut the margin spread to the trained-R2 spread of about 0.03?
